conviction_note: No news dated today; the fall is the second straight leg (10-09 -16.2%, 10-12 -17.7% to $3.89) after a $4.0m registered direct at $6.122 that put ~653k share-equivalents (116,545 shares + 536,836 immediately exercisable, registered pre-funded warrants) into the hands of one underwater investor against 1.28m shares outstanding. That supply is not countable as spent, so the lean is mildly negative. Company issuance cannot add supply tonight (ATM cut to zero, baby-shelf room used, 30-day standstill), which partly offsets it. Scaled number: abs 9 x (2*0.45-1) = -0.9. Findings sum -1.0. The two agree.

cause.label: equity_offering
cause.what_happened: On 2026-10-08 bioAffinity sold ~$4.0m of common stock and pre-funded warrants at $6.122 to one institutional investor through WallachBeth, with 980,072 unregistered warrants at $6.122, and closed on 10-09. No new filing or press release is dated 10-10 to 10-12. The stock fell 16.2% on 10-09 and 17.7% intraday today (volume 0.95x its 20-day median, almost all of it intraday), which looks like the placement investor selling its exercised pre-funded shares. That is an inference, not a disclosed trade.

findings.finding: The 10-08 placement investor holds up to ~653k share-equivalents bought at $6.12, about 51% of the 1.28m shares outstanding. The pre-funded warrants are registered and exercisable at $0.007 behind a 4.99% cap, so the shares can be exercised and sold into the 10-13 session, as the last two sessions suggest they have been.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The pre-funded warrants are immediately exercisable and the shares were sold off an effective S-3, so they are freely tradable now and the supply can hit the tape on 10-13. Nothing dates the end of this selling, and no filing shows how much has been sold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the June 2026 S-1 offering (424B4 2026-06-18) the 06-16 fall of -31.0% was followed by -12.0% the next day. After the August 14 private placement, the 08-13 and 08-19 falls were followed by +5.0% and -2.2%. Baseline history.events.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken two days of selling (-16%, -18%) and no more. If it held the whole overhang, the drop would have come on capitulation volume. It did not: today's volume is 0.95x the 20-day median, about 230k shares at the screen against up to 653k placed. The 4.99% cap also stretches the investor's selling across sessions rather than clearing it in one.
findings.independence: The tape only: two consecutive large intraday falls from the closing date on, with no other filing or press release (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001712762.json). No second source shows the investor's selling.

findings.finding: The company itself cannot add supply tonight. On 10-08 it cut its WallachBeth ATM capacity to zero because its baby-shelf room is used up, and it agreed to a 30-day bar on new issuance and a 6-month bar on variable-rate deals.
findings.mechanism_in_window: This governs the window directly: the most common second shoe for a falling microcap, an overnight ATM draw or shelf takedown, is contractually and regulatorily unavailable between 10-12 and 10-13.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The company raised capital in June (S-1), August (private placement) and October (registered direct), so dilution is its habit. This is the first time the ATM has been formally set to zero. Comparable history: none.
findings.why_not_priced: A reader who sees a microcap fall 18% after a raise usually prices a further draw. If the price held that this one is blocked, there would be no fear of another company sale at all. The cut is in a supplement most of the tape will not have opened.
findings.independence: The 8-K of 10-09 states the ATM suspension separately: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1712762/000149315226046548/form8-k.htm

outside_window.finding: Special meeting (PRE 14A, date blank) to approve exercise of the August Series A/B warrants (1,128,272 shares at ~$7.09 after the split) and authority for up to 10,000,000 shares in non-public offerings at up to a 35% discount, almost 8x the shares outstanding. This is a large dilution overhang, but no meeting date or DEF 14A exists.
Resale registration of the 980,072 October private warrants is due within 45 days and must be effective within 90 days; the warrants are out of the money at $6.122 against $3.89 spot.
Q3 results, Zacks estimate 2026-11-13 (not company-announced); the 10-06 release already said CyPath Lung sales were up more than 100% through Q3.

baseline_tension: Mixed. The ordinary volume (0.95x) argues against continuation under the cross-sectional rule (+1.46% under 2x). The 21.8% ATR, the name's own comparable falls (median -2.2%, 36.6% up) and an unspent placement overhang argue for it. So p_up sits only slightly below 50, while the very wide own-history dispersion keeps abs_move_pct high.
